title: Preview an alpha series repeatedly without consuming or incrementing it

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: Configure an alpha prerelease series for our pending API minor release. Use the planned stable version as the base, increment numbering, keep changesets for the eventual stable release, and keep registry publishing off. Save two independently produced JSON previews as alpha-preview-1.json and alpha-preview-2.json. This is planning only: no manifest changes, changelog writes, or prerelease state file yet.
expectation: Both previews plan main at 2.4.0-alpha.0. Repeated preview does not persist prerelease counters, stamp manifests, consume changesets, or write changelogs.

checks.why: Preview must leave the requested series configured with changeset retention and registry publishing disabled.
The final configuration and pending changesets must resolve.
Previewing twice must not increment alpha numbering.

checks.command: monochange preview --format json | node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),a=require("node:assert/strict"),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8")); a.equal(p.release_targets.length,1); a.equal(p.release_targets[0].id,"main"); a.equal(p.release_targets[0].version,"2.4.0-alpha.0");'
checks.why: The saved previews must agree with the repository's live configuration.
A preview cannot mutate release state or consume intent.
Prerelease preview must leave package versions untouched.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
